name: smwmusic-jesus-dream-for-two-two-people-in-a-dream-remix
title: Jesus - Dream for Two ~ Two People In a Dream (Remix)
description:
My submission to 120hoSPC#10, which won 2nd place.

Per the rules of the contest, this song only uses one sample (@13). The tune itself is heavily remixed, with a sort of "1950's jazz" style to it. I would've liked to have captured more of the counter-melody that the original has going on, what with this being a song about two people and all, but I'm still content with how it came out.

I realized the song sounded good when I slowed it in the SPC player with pitch sync on, so I added a "Slowed & Reverb" toggle option.

(And no, the game has nothing to do with the Jesus you're thinking of, it's a spaceship :))
